actions.text-to-image.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using ModelsLab.
actions.text-to-image.props.guidance_sca: How closely the image follows the prompt (1–20).
actions.text-to-image.props.height.descr: Image height in pixels (256–1024, divisible by 8).
actions.text-to-image.props.model_id.des: The model to use for image generation.
actions.text-to-image.props.negative_pro: Things to exclude from the image.
actions.text-to-image.props.prompt.descr: The text prompt to generate an image from.
actions.text-to-image.props.seed.descrip: Random seed for reproducibility (-1 for random).
actions.text-to-image.props.width.descri: Image width in pixels (256–1024, divisible by 8).
